description.value: Cafe Mt Robson is a historic stop at the base of Mount Robson Provincial Park, operating for over 100 years along Yellowhead Highway 16 between Jasper and McBride. The cafe micro-roasts organic, fairly traded coffee in small batches and offers a broad menu spanning espresso drinks, Napoli-style pizza, chuck wagon BBQ burgers, soups, and homemade baked goods. Sitting at the gateway to the tallest peak in the Canadian Rockies and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, it is a natural landmark rest stop for cyclists riding the Yellowhead corridor.

address.value: 18344 Yellowhead Highway 16, Mount Robson, BC, Canada
